reserveReview.rationale: Source-scoped accounting correction reviewed 2026-10-20; original 2026-09-29 review start and composition pin retained. Historical Ethereum block 26083816 (2026-09-29T14:47:11Z) records asset() as USDD 0x4f8e5de400de08b164e7421b3ee387f461becd1a, totalAssets() of 198738616.64 USDD, 186200657.69 sUSDD shares and zero idle USDD. The exact verified SavingsUsdd code explains the zero balance: _mint transfers USDD, calls UsddJoin.join and Pot.join, then increases share supply; _burn decreases share supply and calls Pot.exit and UsddJoin.exit. totalAssets() is converted share accounting, not a measurement of external strategy assets. The position is therefore the high-risk USDD savings/Pot claim linked to the parent, not independently measured Smart Allocator venue positions. Issuer terms describe anytime USDD withdrawal with no lock-up. Parent reserve, peg and governance risks remain inherited; no current balance, venue allocation, financial assurance or legal safeguard is inferred from this source correction.
